card.name: Linking words before route or drug names
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (comma, 'not', 'be', 'and', 'of') in drug-label text, just before a drug name or an administration route such as 'given' or 'administered'.

modes.label: Comma in drug lists
modes.description: A comma between drug names in a list of related drugs.
modes.example: hypersensitivity reaction to abacavir<<,>> dolutegravir [see W

modes.label: Negated administration
modes.description: 'not' or 'be' in a warning not to give a drug a certain way.
modes.example: RETROVIR injection should not<< be>> given intramuscularly.

modes.label: Linking word before a term
modes.description: 'and' or 'of' right after a drug or measure name, before a following term.
modes.example: Extravasation<< of>> phenylephrine can cause necrosis

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in drug labels, such as the 'not be' in 'should not be given' or the comma between drug names.
